pages.title: Optimiser
pages.text: A marble bowl and a brass ball on a long arm: it rolls downhill a step at a time, and learns how long a step to take.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the step h and the number of steps n. Each step multiplies the distance from the bottom by |1 − hλ|; after n steps what is left, |1 − hλ|ⁿ, must be under the recipe's tolerance. Above hλ = 2 it overshoots further every step. Fewer steps are faster: a step of exactly 1/λ lands at once.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Metamaterial Sheet, Optimised Pathway.
